scientific_integrity: Elementary proof via pointwise convexity, linearization, and conditional two-by-two singular values. Finite numerical diagnostics supplement but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Not an Lp theorem for p other than 2; not a statement for general Markov semigroups. Earlier two-step martingale or conditional Bellman results might imply the norm formula under equivalent terminology. No independent priority review.
scientific_scope: Exact L2 maximal-operator norm of P+exp(-t)(I-P), for a conditional expectation P on any probability space, and its lazy discrete powers; finite uniform-atom classification.
title: Exact maximal norms of projection-relaxation Markov semigroups
